node.title: The full t-petal cell is an owner-free weighted Cauchy divisor census
node.statement: For a saturated t-petal pair slice, let chi be the CRT multiplier equal to label c_i modulo petal locator L_i. Every core-split locator G reconstructs anchor-freely as B_G=rem_Lambda(chi G). The degree condition deg B_G<=d is exactly a printed block of h-d-1 weighted moments on the petal roots; primitivity is exactly nonvanishing of the corresponding punctured zeroth moment at every root of G, and every background zero is exactly one printed Cauchy-transform equation. Equivalently the entire guarded cell is one reciprocal-divisor census over complements of G in the core locator, without summing joint owners.
